plugins.name: view-limits
plugins.description: Check coding-plan credit and rate-limit status across providers before dispatching sub-agents.

plugins.name: jev
plugins.description: Decide when and how to integrate TypeSafe's Jev decision model: access paths (TypeSafe, OpenRouter, Vercel, Cloudflare), framework choice, harness patterns (tool gates, routers, triage), calibration and production ops.

plugins.name: enigma
plugins.description: Local-only MCP secret request/reveal server (CLI + Claude Code plugin): request a named secret via a one-time URL; the value never returns to the agent. `enigma_reveal` discloses it to the human directly; `enigma run` injects it into a child process's environment (ADR-001). Repo-level project scope (0.3.0): secrets saved from a worktree, symlinked clone path, or submodule need `enigma migrate-scope` after upgrade.
